title: delphinium orientale subsp. hispanicum
intro: Delphinium orientale subsp. hispanicum, commonly known as Spanish blue delphinium, is a flowering plant species within the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Delphinium orientale subsp. hispanicum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
